$comment: Shape returned by kaggle_accounts action='list' / 'status'. The widget transforms this; it never fetches it and never sees a token.

configured.description: Whether any credential resolves. false means the panel must show an empty state instead of a rename control.

active.description: Stored name of the active account, or null when none.

accounts.description: Every saved account. Never contains a token.

name.description: Stored name. This is the value every tool call uses, and the `from` of a rename.

username.description: Kaggle identity. Primary label, and the proposed new name.

display.description: Prefer this for the primary label: it is the username when known, else the name.

active.description: Exactly one account is active; the active pointer follows a rename.

added.description: When the account was first stored. A rename does not change it.

renamed_from.description: Previous name, as a chain like 'work -> qwyi123'. Null when never renamed. Shown once so a user can find a token filed under the old label.

displayRules.identityFirst: Lead with username; show the stored name only when it differs, so a user-chosen alias stays visible without looking like the account.
displayRules.activeMarker: The active account is marked, not reordered away - position carries no meaning the user chose.
displayRules.noToken: No field in this shape is a credential. The widget must never display or send one.
displayRules.sameNameIsNoOp: When name == username, the panel states that renaming would change nothing and does not push the action.
displayRules.emptyAccounts: accounts.length === 0 is an explicit empty state naming kaggle_accounts action='add', not an error.

validation.nameRule: 1-64 characters, must start with a letter or digit, then letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Mirrors the tool's NAME_RE so feedback is instant; the tool still has the final say.
validation.takenName: A new name equal to another account's name is refused by the tool. The widget disables confirm and says so, rather than letting the user hit an error.
